concerns.confirmed_behavior: v0.9.24: sample size and quality no longer enter influence_weight. They inflate observation precision once via poll_se = 100/sqrt(n)/sqrt(qw)/sqrt(iw) in pymc_model._prepare and obs_var = (100/sqrt(n))^2 / (qw*iw) in state_space.fit_state_space, where iw carries absolute recency / clustering only.
v0.9.24: within-race renormalization applies only to non-recency structural factors; absolute calendar recency exp(-ln2 * age / half_life) is multiplied back afterward.
v0.9.24: fit_state_space accumulates process variance as (0.8 pp/√day)^2 × calendar Δt between successive polls; same-day Δt = 0 (no fixed +0.8^2 per poll).
